description: Governance manifest for the statutory enrichment layer: statutory text retrieved from the Illinois General Assembly and joined to the frozen 2024 source corpus. This layer never modifies src/data/offense-codes.json.

ilga.notes: ILGA answers HTTP 200 with an in-band 'not currently available' notice for sections that do not exist, so HTTP status is not a validity signal. Validity is established by the citation echoed in the embedded document title. The legacy fulltext.asp path returned 404 for every probed section on 2026-08-17.

affiliation.statement: This project is not operated by, endorsed by, or affiliated with the Illinois General Assembly, the Illinois Secretary of State, or the Illinois State Police. Official links are references only.

review.statement: Statutory text in this layer was retrieved and fingerprinted automatically. Automated retrieval establishes what ILGA published on a given date; it does not constitute legal review, and no record in this layer is certified as current law.
